title: Teaching pupils in Chicago
summary: He taught about forty pupils and gave them too much time.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: When did you start teaching? Did you have any pupils in New Orleans?

Well, I had, no, I had more pupils here than I had in New Orleans. I had about, I had about 40. I had about... Really? About 12 white boys from over on the west side. And then I had more, well, more than 40 of us. They'd come every other night. I wasn't doing nothing but teaching them. I didn't have to worry. I was teaching them on different instruments, see. And they'd come in the night. And the only thing about me was, when I was teaching, I give a man too much time. See, I couldn't, I can't get away from that. I'm just taking up in it and I know when you're doing good. I want to see you do good and I'll forget about the time. Some teachers will hold it. A half hour, yeah. Every half hour. You had to go, see. And sometimes, my wife used to tell me, say, my goodness, did you teach a fellow that long? Or that long? You say, well, no, it isn't that. I see them doing good and I just get, you know, in me that I want to see them still do and do better. That's why I hold myself over that way. But as far as teaching, I believe I can learn any of them, anything. If they listen at me and go the way I want them to go, see, it'll be easier for them like this boy there. You should hear him. Is he still around playing here in Chicago? Yeah, he's around now, but he's been kind of sick, see, and he ain't been playing much. They got him off the trumpet for a while, see. He's a young kid. He's about 18 or 19 years old. But he's good. All that drawl was stuck, all that diminishes and stuff like Louis Armstrong play. And he picked that up himself, see. I got him one of those methods we just called, Auburn Method. And got him, he didn't get all the way through it, see. He just got to about a little on the other side of half. That boy was doing things that way. I'll be the best way to instruct a person, take them slow. Let them see slow, let they, they'll work up fast on it, see. Just let them go along slow and go along, make them divide it right. And when you let them loose, they're gone. Go with itself, see. Yeah. Because he got the right way to go, see. A whole lot of fellas, teacher fellas, they don't, can I just give me the money. That's all they want, give me the money. That takes too much interest in my scholars. That's the trouble. My wife used to give me the sins. I'm tired of holding a fella like he's teaching them half an hour. And that clock would be 25 minutes. I wouldn't let them loose some time until they're 25 minutes too. See, well that's that man gaining. I'm cheating myself out of about 15 or 20 minutes, see. Yeah. I could have the other fella there, see. So.
